# A conversation of Discover requests, played against the pod by TestXMLAConversations
# (xmla_conversation_test.go) with the «sales» table of xmla_discover_test.go.
#
# NOT RECORDED FROM A REAL CLIENT. It is written from the protocol's documentation, in the order
# a spreadsheet's pivot table is documented to ask when it connects, lists the cubes and the fields
# of one, and expands a field. The owner's trials with the real client replace it: put the
# request exactly as the pod received it under a new «===» step and say what the answer must be.
#
# Format. A step starts with a line «=== name». Lines starting with «@» come next, and say how it
# is sent: «@key orders» sends the key of that name in the test fixture (main is the default).
# The request, the SOAP envelope as sent, follows up to the line «--- expect», and then come the
# expectations, one to a line:
#
#   status 200                 the HTTP status (200 when not said)
#   columns A B C              the rowset's columns, exactly, in this order
#   rows N                     how many rows
#   row A=x | B=y              the next row, the columns it names only (a value may be empty)
#   fault some text            the answer is a SOAP fault (HTTP 500) with this text in it
#
# The «row» lines check the first rows, in order; «rows» says how many there are in all.

=== the pivot asks which data sources there are
<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soap:Body><Discover xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-analysis"><RequestType>DISCOVER_DATASOURCES</RequestType><Restrictions><RestrictionList/></Restrictions><Properties><PropertyList><Catalog>CRM</Catalog><Content>SchemaData</Content><Format>Tabular</Format><LocaleIdentifier>1033</LocaleIdentifier></PropertyList></Properties></Discover></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>
--- expect
columns DataSourceName DataSourceDescription URL DataSourceInfo ProviderName ProviderType AuthenticationMode
rows 1
row DataSourceName=Tabularia | ProviderName=Tabularia | ProviderType=MDP | AuthenticationMode=Authenticated

=== the properties of the server
<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soap:Body><Discover xmlns="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xml-analysis"><RequestType>DISCOVER_PROPERTIES</RequestType><Restrictions><RestrictionList><PropertyName>ProviderVersion</PropertyName></RestrictionList></Restrictions><Properties><PropertyList><Catalog>CRM</Catalog><Content>SchemaData</Content><Format>Tabular</Format><LocaleIdentifier>1033</LocaleIdentifier></PropertyList></Properties></Discover></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>
--- expect
rows 1
row PropertyName=ProviderVersion | PropertyAccessType=Read
